I am a **postdoctoral researcher** in BETSAKA project conducted jointly by the [Malagasy National Research Center in Developement Economics (CERED)](https://albatross-project.eu/consortium/centre-detudes-et-de-recherchers-economiques-pour-le-developpement/) at Antananarivo University and the [ French National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD)](https://en.ird.fr/), part-time lecturer in Economic Mention in the [Faculty of Economic, Gestion and Sociology](https://mg.linkedin.com/company/facult%C3%A9-egs-economie-gestion-sociologie-universit%C3%A9-antananarivo) at Antananarivo University , member of the [Doctoral research team (EAD)](https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8) at the [Ecole Doctoral Ecosystèmes Naturels (EDEN)] (https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8at) at [Mahajanga University](https://www.mahajanga-univ.mg/)

I have a background in applied mathematics and statistics, specializing in actuarial science during my university studies at Aix-Marseille University.


I completed my PhD at [Ecole Doctorale Ecosystèmes Naturels](https://hayka.mg/ed/ecosyst%C3%A8mes-naturels-8at) in January 2025, under the supervision of [Senior Professor Hery Lisy Tiana RANARIJAONA](https://mg.linkedin.com/in/hery-lisy-tiana-ranarijaona-19707369) and [Senior Professor Heriniaina RAMANANKIERANA](https://mg.linkedin.com/in/heriniaina-ramanankierana-aa9336a8).

You can contact me at my [email adress](mailto:v.ramizason@gmail.com).
